finding.expected: Preserve the raw observed group and selected-option strings byte/text-for-text in selected_variants and in the resulting ProductFact value. Trimming/strip may be used only on a temporary value to test whether a label is nonblank; it must not replace the retained observation. Add focused DOM and ProductSourcePack regressions using leading/trailing whitespace (including an attribute-backed label and a rendered-text label) proving the embedded strings remain exact while blank-only labels still fail closed. Do not change ProductFact schema, TASK-108 semantics, readiness, media, or any other authority.
finding.issue: TASK-172 requires selected-variant ProductFact values to embed the exact observed group and option strings without trimming or normalization. The Shopee DOM extractor currently calls .trim() when reading aria/data group labels, fallback group text, and selected option labels, then stores those trimmed values in result.selected_variants. The Python layer therefore cannot recover the original observed strings and emits normalized-by-trimming ProductFact values. Existing tests use labels without leading/trailing whitespace, so Runtime verification does not detect this semantic loss.
